adaptations: Locally authored full pointer-tree workload using the language’s general standard arena allocator. Every leaf/interior makes a separate equal-size Node allocation; both children are recursively allocated. Temporary arenas reset only after complete construction/check; stretch storage is released before a separately allocated long-lived tree, which remains live through all temporary work. Application allocator/thread plumbing counts toward LOC. No flat/indexed tree or native executor.
